verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack describes any telemetry or usage-tracking mechanism in Keycloak, nor any opt-out configuration; the metrics endpoint mentioned (keycloak-docs-44) is for operators monitoring their own self-hosted instance, not vendor telemetry collection. Since Keycloak is self-hosted software where telemetry/opt-out is a plausible axis to ask about, absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
